evidence.text:
[Swords > White Sword]
Damage: 2
The white sword is the second sword Link gets in the game. It is twice as powerful than the wooden sword, but less powerful than the magic sword. Link must have five Heart Containers before he can receive the white sword. In both quests it is found in Section 3.

[Get the white sword]
Follow the lake shore south, east and north. When the landscape changes to brown trees, go north one more screen. In that screen, burn the green tree in the lower-right to get 30 Rupees.
Now, continue west one screen, then follow the river in the eastern mountains. Follow the river up to its spring, and in a cave on the same screen you'll be given the White Sword , but only if you have six heart containers (D1 in Section 3).

[Summary]
You can now enter Dungeon 1 equipped with:
- 6 Heart Containers instead of 3
- White Sword instead of Wooden sword
- Magical Shield instead of the small shield
- Blue Ring
- Bombs, Blue Candle, Red Potion and Power Bracelet
- Arrows and bait (to be used later)

[Boss]
- The boss is Aquamentus. You must strike him in the head six times with the Wooden Sword or three times with the White Sword. Time your strikes between the energy orbs that he emits from his horn. Only the Magical Shield will absorb the energy orbs. Link will receive damage if he tries to block them with the regular shield. If you're firing sword beams, you can strike any part of his body. If you have less than full health and actually have to approach him to slash, only the head is vulnerable.
- Defeat him to earn a Heart Container. Enter the room to the right to obtain the first Piece of Triforce.

[1st Quest]
A-1: See Section 5
D-1: In this very important cave, you can obtain the White Sword, but only if you have at least 5 Heart Containers in your Life Meter. The White Sword has double the power of the Wooden Sword.
E-1: Reach this area to find the entrance to the fifth dungeon, but beware; the distance you must hike up the hills to reach the top can be deceptive.
D-2: The waterfall hides a secret cave, where you can learn from the old lady how to get over the Lost Hills if you give her 20 rupees. If you pay less, she won't tell you anything.
E-2: These are the Lost Hills. Unprepared wanderers can feel as if they are making no progress through this area, but persistent climbers know that the only way to reach the top is to keep climbing.
A-3: If you bomb the north wall all the way to the right, you will uncover the entrance to a medicine woman. If you have shown her the letter, she will sell you a Red Potion for 68 rupees or a Water of Life for 40 rupees.
B-3: Just before the entrance to the desert, burn the lower rightmost tree to reveal a stairwell. Down the stairs is a Red Moblin that will donate 30 Rupees to your cause.

[B Button items > Candles]
Damage: 1
Candles throw a flame a short distance. The Blue Candle can only be used once per screen. The Red Candle has the same effect as the blue candle, except there is no limit to the number of times it can be used per screen. Candles can light up dark rooms in dungeons, burn bushes in the overworld, and damage enemies in both.

[Automatic items > Raft]
Allows Link to cross lakes and oceans, but it can only be used at a Dock. Neither of the 'double docks' trigger raft use.

evidence.text:
[(intro)]
^ Section 3 ^
← Section 6 | Section 2 →
[1st Quest]
A-1: See Section 3
B-1: This is one of the magical lakes where a life refilling fairy lives. Visit here to restore your health.
C-1: See Section 3
A-2: Burn the topmost tree along the right border to reveal a cave where you can receive 30 rupees.
B-2: This is one of the secret passage exits. You must have the Power Bracelet in order to move the rock which opens the entrance to the passage. The passage links to the other exits in Section 1, Section 7, and directly to the south.
C-2: The store inside of the cave sells (the ability to use) Arrows for 80 rupees, the Magical Shield for 130 rupees, and a set of 4 Bombs for 20 rupees.
D-2: Burn one of the trees closest to the entrance to the desert to find a stairwell that leads to a medicine woman. If you've shown her the Letter, you can buy Red Potions for 68 rupees, and Water of Lifes for 40 rupees.
D-3: If you burn down the lower solitary tree on the left, you will reveal a stairwell that leads to 10 Rupees.
A-4: By burning the bottom leftmost tree, you will discover a stairwell, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.

[1st Quest]
C-4: Burn the bottom solitary tree, and you will reveal another stairwell, but the man who lives there will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
D-4: Burn down the bottom center tree among the group of trees on the right to find a stairwell. Venture down the stairs to find a Red Moblin that is willing to part with 100 Rupees.
A-5: Burn down the bottom center tree among the group of trees on the left to reveal a stairwell that leads to a medicine woman. If you've shown her the Letter, you can buy Red Potions for 68 rupees, and Water of Lifes for 40 rupees.
B-5: This is one of the secret passage exits. You must have the Power Bracelet in order to move the rock which opens the entrance to the passage. The passage links to the other exits in Section 1, Section 7, and directly to the north.
D-5: If you bomb the wall to the left of the north path, you will reveal a cave where you can obtain a Heart Container.

[1st Quest]
D-4: Bomb the wall between the two staircases to reveal the entrance to a cave where a medicine woman lives. If you have shown her the Letter, she will sell you a Red Potion for 68 Rupees, or a Water of Life for 40 Rupees.
C-5: See Section 8

[Old Woman]
Many women make their homes in Hyrule's caves and trees. It is common for the women of Hyrule to know the secrets to making the Water of Life, a Hyrulian recipe that restores the strength of those who drink it. However, they only sell this concoction to those who present the special Letter to them. Other women in Hyrule offer important information about the nearby vicinity, but sometimes only after being well compensated.

[Old Man (Overworld)]
A variety of men live in Hyrule's overworld as well. Like the women of Hyrule, they may dispense information. Hyrulian men are also fond of gambling and will play the Money Making game with anyone who will part with their rupees. There are also some old men, who live in well hidden caves, who will give Link a Red Water of Life or a Heart Container of his choice. However, some men of Hyrule prefer to be left alone. If you reveal their location by destroying their secret entrance, expect to be forced to compensate them for the repairs.
